SCOPE DECISION NEEDED: if the Controller/Architect rules that "production" means the Core engine only, the cited predicate becomes admissible once its window is replaced by a whole-file count. That ruling is not mine to make silently, so the row is returned FAIL rather than PASS under a private assumption.
